A place to settle in

Make room for a slower kind of getaway.

A comfortable cottage, a change of scenery, and the lake close at hand.

Emmet’s Place puts you in Miller Beach, a distinctive lakeside neighborhood at the edge of Indiana Dunes country. Come for fresh air and long walks; leave space in the day for whatever feels good.

Take a look around, then tell us when you’re hoping to visit. We’ll follow up about availability and the details of your stay.

A little more than a place to sleep

Come for the lake. Stay for the feeling.

Start with a slow morning, head out to explore the lakeshore, and come back to a place that feels like yours for a while. Emmet’s Place is here for beach weekends, family time, and the in-between seasons too.

We’ll add the cottage’s exact room, amenity, and guest details alongside your photos so visitors can picture their stay with confidence.

Out the door and into dune country

Discover Miller Beach and the Indiana Dunes.

Miller Beach brings together Lake Michigan’s shoreline, a creative neighborhood feel, and access to the wider Indiana Dunes region. Make the cottage your starting point for exploring the coast.

Make a day of it

Things to do in Miller Beach.

Follow a dune trail, take in the lakeshore, wander the Lake Street arts district, or settle in for something good to eat. Check the linked sites for current hours, seasonal access, and event dates.

01 · Outside

Beach, trails & parkland

Marquette Park

A 241-acre lakefront park with beaches, trails, a lagoon, the historic Aquatorium, playground, and disc golf.

Plan a visit

Miller Woods & Paul H. Douglas Trail

Walk through wetlands, oak savanna, open dunes, and beach in this Indiana Dunes National Park trail area.

See trail details

West Beach

Explore another Lake Michigan beach and dune landscape in Indiana Dunes National Park.

Visit the park page
02 · Around the table

Local places to eat & drink

Tiny’s Coffee Bar

Coffee, breakfast, lunch, dinner, and a full-service bar in the Miller Beach business district.

Visit Tiny’s

Estella’s Cantina

Tacos and cocktails, with a menu built around favorites like al pastor, steak, chicken, and chorizo.

Visit Estella’s

Beach Box

A relaxed Lake Street stop for cocktails, hot dogs, and Cajun-inspired food.

Visit Beach Box

Flamingo Pizza of Miller

A neighborhood bar and grill known for stone-baked pizza, lake perch, burgers, and a lively local feel.

Find Flamingo Pizza

More neighborhood favorites

Try a local pint at 18th Street Brewery or pick up pizza from Miller Pizza Company.

18th Street Brewery · Miller Pizza
03 · Arts & neighborhood events

Find the local rhythm

Lake Street arts district

Browse murals, galleries, independent shops, and creative spaces around downtown Miller Beach.

Explore the community map

Fest in the First

A neighborhood street festival celebrating local businesses, artists, nonprofits, and community groups.

Festival details

Flamingo Fest

Flamingo Pizza’s end-of-summer celebration, with live music and a festive neighborhood atmosphere. It’s usually around Labor Day weekend, so the date can land in late August or early September.

Follow Flamingo Pizza for updates

Lake Effekt Mural Fest

Look for this outdoor mural event from the Miller Beach Arts & Creative District.
